title: 用户输入
problem_statement_md: 编写一个程序，输入一个字符串，并在该字符串开头和结尾添加3颗星`***`作为输出。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Taking User Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re working on a notification system and need to make the notification text eye-catching.

Write a program that takes the text as input and outputs it by adding 3 stars at the beginning and the end.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
this is awesome

[b]Sample Output[/b]
*** this is awesome ***

[note]Note, there are [b]spaces[/b] between the stars and the text.[/note]
hint_md: 注意，`***`和文本之间有空格。
